sketch:
Observe: schematic with a variable pile (E slider) and a resistor
slot; student swaps resistor cartridges (10 Ω, 47 Ω, 100 Ω …) and
watches I vs. U populate a small live scatter plot. The Ohm-line
slope emerges as they add points. Experiment: given a target
resistance R and voltage U, student picks the resistor + adjusts E
until the ammeter reads the target I. Evaluate: I/U scatter shown
without the resistor label; student reads slope and picks the matching
resistor from a bin. Wrinkle: a light-bulb "resistor" in the palette
curves the I(U) line — foreshadows non-ohmic dipoles.
